## Purpose

Import and validate the plot-level Yellow Mammoth workbook, standardize variables,
and save a reproducible processed dataset. No statistical analyses are performed.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

## User-supplied measurement parameters

The workbook records biomass per 0.5 m². The field protocol specifies two
8.75-ft row transects for initial and final stands, and four 8.75-ft row
transects for harvest stands and grain, all in 30-inch corn rows. These
correspond to sampled ground areas of approximately 4.065 m² and 8.129 m², respectively.
Grain was dried to approximately 0% moisture. Raw dry-grain yield is retained,
and the primary grain-yield variable is adjusted to 15.5% moisture.

```{r parameters}
biomass_quadrat_m2 <- 0.5
biomass_detection_limit_g <- 0.01
biomass_trace_substitute_g <- biomass_detection_limit_g / 2

# Corn row spacing at both sites.
corn_row_spacing_in <- 30
transect_length_ft <- 8.75
initial_stand_n_transects <- 2
final_stand_n_transects <- 2
harvest_stand_n_transects <- 4
grain_harvest_n_transects <- 4
observed_grain_moisture_pct <- 0
target_grain_moisture_pct <- 15.5

# Exact mass/area conversion constants; shelled corn uses 56 lb per bushel.
kg_per_lb <- 0.45359237
m2_per_acre <- 4046.8564224
acres_per_ha <- 10000 / m2_per_acre
corn_lb_per_bu <- 56

row_spacing_m <- corn_row_spacing_in * 0.0254
transect_length_m <- transect_length_ft * 0.3048
initial_stand_area_m2 <- initial_stand_n_transects * transect_length_m * row_spacing_m
final_stand_area_m2 <- final_stand_n_transects * transect_length_m * row_spacing_m
harvest_stand_area_m2 <- harvest_stand_n_transects * transect_length_m * row_spacing_m
grain_harvest_area_m2 <- grain_harvest_n_transects * transect_length_m * row_spacing_m

stopifnot(is.finite(biomass_quadrat_m2), biomass_quadrat_m2 > 0)
optional_areas <- c(initial_stand_area_m2, final_stand_area_m2,
                    harvest_stand_area_m2, grain_harvest_area_m2)
stopifnot(all(is.na(optional_areas) | (is.finite(optional_areas) & optional_areas > 0)))
stopifnot(is.finite(transect_length_ft), transect_length_ft > 0)
stopifnot(observed_grain_moisture_pct >= 0, observed_grain_moisture_pct < 100,
          target_grain_moisture_pct >= 0, target_grain_moisture_pct < 100)
```

## Import and verify structure

Place the original workbook at `data/raw/combined_raw.xlsx` in the Git repository.
Do not edit the raw workbook as part of this workflow.

```{r import}
raw_path <- here("data", "raw", "combined_raw.xlsx")
stopifnot(file.exists(raw_path))

raw <- readxl::read_excel(raw_path, sheet = 1)

required_columns <- c(
  "id", "location", "year", "block", "plot", "clover_species", "management",
  "spring_weed_biomass_g_0_5m2", "spring_legume_biomass_g_0_5m2",
  "initial_stand_count", "final_stand_count",
  "peak_weed_biomass_g_0_5m2", "peak_legume_biomass_g_0_5m2",
  "harvest_stand_count", "grain_weight_g"
)
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(raw))
if (length(missing_columns)) stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
if (!nrow(raw)) stop("The raw workbook has no observations.")

unexpected_columns <- setdiff(names(raw), required_columns)
if (length(unexpected_columns)) message("Additional columns retained: ",
                                        paste(unexpected_columns, collapse = ", "))
```

## Standardize identifiers and treatment codes

Species and management are separate experimental factors; retain each source
code and the combined treatment. The `whole_plot_id` below assumes that clover
species defines the whole-plot unit within each site-year and block. **Confirm
this assignment against the randomization map before statistical modeling.**

The combined IDs are convenience columns derived from the original design
variables, not additional experimental factors. `site_year` combines location
and year; `block_id` identifies blocks uniquely across site-years;
`whole_plot_id` identifies the clover whole plots; and `plot_id` identifies
individual subplots. Equivalent grouping variables can be constructed later
inside analysis scripts.

```{r standardize}
numeric_columns <- c(
  "spring_weed_biomass_g_0_5m2", "spring_legume_biomass_g_0_5m2",
  "initial_stand_count", "final_stand_count", "peak_weed_biomass_g_0_5m2",
  "peak_legume_biomass_g_0_5m2", "harvest_stand_count", "grain_weight_g"
)
biomass_columns <- c(
  "spring_weed_biomass_g_0_5m2", "spring_legume_biomass_g_0_5m2",
  "peak_weed_biomass_g_0_5m2", "peak_legume_biomass_g_0_5m2"
)

# Blank columns can be imported as logical, and numeric cells stored as
# text can make a whole column character. Convert only after checking values.
# Explicit missing-value codes: blanks, NA, and N/A (case-insensitive).
# Other entries, including dashes and notes, require review rather than
# silently becoming missing values.
measurement_issues <- list()
for (column in numeric_columns) {
  values <- trimws(as.character(raw[[column]]))
  missing <- is.na(values) | toupper(values) %in% c("", "NA", "N/A")
  values[missing] <- NA_character_

  if (column %in% biomass_columns) {
    # Preserve source entries and distinguish trace biomass from true zeros.
    raw[[paste0(column, "_raw")]] <- as.character(raw[[column]])
    below_detection <- !missing & gsub("[[:space:]]", "", values) == "<0.01"
    raw[[paste0(column, "_below_detection")]] <- ifelse(
      missing, NA, below_detection
    )
    values[below_detection] <- as.character(biomass_trace_substitute_g)
  }

  converted <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(values))
  invalid <- !missing & (is.na(converted) | !is.finite(converted))

  if (any(invalid)) {
    measurement_issues[[column]] <- data.frame(
      variable = column,
      data_row = which(invalid),
      id = as.character(raw$id[invalid]),
      value = values[invalid],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  raw[[column]] <- converted
}

if (length(measurement_issues)) {
  issues <- do.call(rbind, measurement_issues)
  details <- sprintf("%s | data row %s | id %s | value: %s",
                     issues$variable, issues$data_row, issues$id,
                     shQuote(issues$value))
  stop("Measurement values could not be converted to finite numbers:\n",
       paste(details, collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
}

species_codes <- c("MRC", "YBSC")
management_codes <- c("TILL", "ST", "V4IRM", "V4BOT", "BWBOT")
if (anyNA(raw[c("location", "year", "block", "plot", "clover_species", "management")])) {
  stop("Missing site, design, or treatment identifiers.")
}
if (!all(raw$clover_species %in% species_codes)) stop("Unrecognized clover species code.")
if (!all(raw$management %in% management_codes)) stop("Unrecognized management code.")

processed <- raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    location = tolower(trimws(as.character(location))),
    year = as.integer(year),
    block = as.integer(block),
    plot = as.integer(plot),
    clover_species_code = as.character(clover_species),
    management_code = as.character(management),
    clover_species = factor(clover_species_code, levels = species_codes,
                            labels = c("Mammoth red clover", "Yellow sweetclover")),
    management = factor(management_code, levels = management_codes,
                        labels = c("Tillage", "Strip-till", "V4 inter-row mowing",
                                   "V4 autonomous mowing", "Between-row autonomous mowing")),
    site_year = paste(location, year, sep = "_"),
    block_id = paste(site_year, block, sep = "_"),
    whole_plot_id = paste(block_id, clover_species_code, sep = "_"),
    plot_id = paste(block_id, plot, sep = "_"),
    treatment = interaction(clover_species, management, sep = " + ", drop = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(raw_id = id)

if (anyDuplicated(processed$plot_id)) stop("Duplicate plot IDs within site-year/block.")
if (anyNA(processed$year) || anyNA(processed$block) || anyNA(processed$plot)) {
  stop("Year, block, or plot could not be converted to integer.")
}
```

## Convert measured variables

Biomass: grams per sampled area × 10,000 m²/ha ÷ 1,000 g/kg.
Stand: counted plants × 10,000 m²/ha ÷ sampled area.
Grain: grams × 10 ÷ harvested m² = kg/ha on the approximately 0%-moisture
basis. Adjusted yield = dry-grain yield × (100 − observed moisture %) /
(100 − target moisture %). For 0% to 15.5%, the factor is 1 / 0.845.

Biomass and adjusted grain yield are also reported in lb/ac:
kg/ha ÷ 0.45359237 ÷ acres per hectare. Corn yield in bu/ac uses
56 lb per bushel: adjusted lb/ac ÷ 56.
Both `grain_yield_lb_ac` and `grain_yield_bu_ac` retain the 15.5%-moisture basis.

```{r conversions}
g_to_kg_ha <- function(x, area_m2) {
  if (is.na(area_m2)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  x * 10 / area_m2
}
count_to_plants_ha <- function(x, area_m2) {
  if (is.na(area_m2)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  x * 10000 / area_m2
}

processed <- processed |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    spring_weed_biomass_kg_ha = g_to_kg_ha(spring_weed_biomass_g_0_5m2, biomass_quadrat_m2),
    spring_legume_biomass_kg_ha = g_to_kg_ha(spring_legume_biomass_g_0_5m2, biomass_quadrat_m2),
    peak_weed_biomass_kg_ha = g_to_kg_ha(peak_weed_biomass_g_0_5m2, biomass_quadrat_m2),
    peak_legume_biomass_kg_ha = g_to_kg_ha(peak_legume_biomass_g_0_5m2, biomass_quadrat_m2),
    initial_stand_plants_ha = count_to_plants_ha(initial_stand_count, initial_stand_area_m2),
    final_stand_plants_ha = count_to_plants_ha(final_stand_count, final_stand_area_m2),
    harvest_stand_plants_ha = count_to_plants_ha(harvest_stand_count, harvest_stand_area_m2),
    grain_yield_dry_kg_ha = g_to_kg_ha(grain_weight_g, grain_harvest_area_m2),
    grain_yield_kg_ha = grain_yield_dry_kg_ha *
      (100 - observed_grain_moisture_pct) / (100 - target_grain_moisture_pct),
    spring_weed_biomass_lb_ac = spring_weed_biomass_kg_ha / kg_per_lb / acres_per_ha,
    spring_legume_biomass_lb_ac = spring_legume_biomass_kg_ha / kg_per_lb / acres_per_ha,
    peak_weed_biomass_lb_ac = peak_weed_biomass_kg_ha / kg_per_lb / acres_per_ha,
    peak_legume_biomass_lb_ac = peak_legume_biomass_kg_ha / kg_per_lb / acres_per_ha,
    grain_yield_lb_ac = grain_yield_kg_ha / kg_per_lb / acres_per_ha,
    grain_yield_bu_ac = grain_yield_lb_ac / corn_lb_per_bu
  )
```

## Data validation

Missing field measurements remain `NA`, rather than being converted to zero or
silently dropped. Actual measured zeros remain zero. Weed and legume biomass entries of `<0.01`
indicate biomass collected but below the 0.01-g detection limit for the entire
0.5-m² sample. These use a documented half-limit substitute of 0.005 g
(0.1 kg/ha) for conversion, not an exact measured weight. Original biomass entries
are retained in columns ending in `_raw`; columns ending in `_below_detection`
flag these substitutions (missing measurements have `NA` flags). Other text
entries still require review. Report unexpected values and missingness without
removing plots.

```{r validation}
if (any(processed[numeric_columns] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop("Negative field measurements detected; inspect the raw workbook.")
}
count_columns <- c("initial_stand_count", "final_stand_count", "harvest_stand_count")
if (any(vapply(processed[count_columns], function(x) any(x != floor(x), na.rm = TRUE), logical(1)))) {
  stop("Non-integer plant stand count detected.")
}

missingness <- data.frame(
  variable = numeric_columns,
  missing_n = vapply(processed[numeric_columns], function(x) sum(is.na(x)), integer(1)),
  observed_n = vapply(processed[numeric_columns], function(x) sum(!is.na(x)), integer(1))
)
knitr::kable(missingness, caption = "Missing observations in source measurements")

design_check <- processed |>
  dplyr::count(location, year, block, clover_species_code, management_code,
               name = "n_plots")
if (any(design_check$n_plots != 1)) {
  stop("Duplicate species-management combinations within a site-year/block.")
}
knitr::kable(processed |>
  dplyr::count(location, year, clover_species_code, management_code, name = "n_plots"),
  caption = "Treatment coverage by site-year")

# The currently observed design differs by location: do not require every
# management treatment at every location when adding new site-years.
knitr::kable(processed |>
  dplyr::count(location, year, block, name = "n_plots"),
  caption = "Plot counts by block")
```

## Export

```{r export}
processed_path <- here("data", "processed", "combined_processed.rds")
dir.create(dirname(processed_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(processed, processed_path)
message("Saved ", nrow(processed), " plots to ", processed_path)
```

## Future additions

Append Wisconsin and other site-years as additional rows using the same core
columns. Additional measurement columns are retained automatically. Update the
allowed factor codes if new treatments are introduced; keep the raw workbook
unchanged and rerun this document. If multiple quadrats or subsamples are added
per plot, preserve their sampling IDs and process them separately rather than
implicitly treating subsamples as independent plot replicates.
